Method

Operational market definition: an AI data lab or human-feedback supplier is included here when an approved public source documents an offering that creates, collects, annotates, curates, validates or evaluates data or executable tasks used in AI development. The category includes services, participant access, software-assisted workflows and environment products. Inclusion means that the scoped offering meets this research definition. It does not assert a legal industry classification, a minimum revenue level, independent ownership, a named downstream contribution or an exclusive business focus.

Analysis

Participant access is one delivery category. Prolific offers selected participants and distinguishes platform access from managed collection; Terac offers verified-expert access with an expert-payout-plus-platform-fee model. Handshake’s contractor agreement describes a Human Data Services program whose onboarding does not guarantee a project. These are useful starting points when the buyer can own task design and acceptance, but the degree of project management and supplier responsibility must be read in the contract. Access to a qualified population is not the same deliverable as an accepted dataset.

Evidence: candidate.supplier.prolific.platform-managed, candidate.supplier.prolific.ai-taskers, candidate.cohort5.terac.expert-supply-offer, candidate.cohort5.terac.buyer-billing-model, candidate.cohort4.handshake_ai.human-data-program, candidate.cohort4.handshake_ai.matching-no-guarantee

Analysis

Managed data production combines personnel, instructions, tools and review. Appen describes expert alignment and evaluation; Sama describes an in-house workforce and human-verified data services; iMerit describes expert review and client audits; DataForce describes expert/native-speaker matching and adjudication. These examples are grouped by disclosed responsibility, not presumed equivalence. A managed-service comparison should identify who writes the rubric, who employs or contracts with contributors, who owns correction work and who can reject a disputed final unit.

Evidence: candidate.supplier.appen.offering, candidate.cohort2.sama.data-offering, candidate.cohort2.sama.employee-delivery, candidate.cohort2.imerit.review-gates, candidate.cohort2.dataforce.selection-adjudication

Analysis

Licensed data products are a different procurement path. Snorkel describes non-exclusive dataset and environment products refreshed quarterly; Mercor, Surge, Datacurve and Invisible advertise prebuilt or ready-to-license collections. Defined.ai explicitly separates marketplace or third-party proprietary datasets from new collection and services. The relevant comparison is therefore version, license, overlap with existing training data, refresh entitlement and fitness on the buyer’s task. A catalog listing does not establish the right to redistribute every source component or the availability of exclusive data.

Evidence: repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.candidate.supplier.snorkel_ai.data-series, repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.candidate.supplier.mercor.catalog, candidate.supplier.surge_ai.ots, candidate.cohort4.datacurve.ots-datasets, candidate.cohort2.invisible.data-catalog, candidate.cohort2.defined_ai.marketplace-separation

Analysis

Environment builders deliver executable tasks, state and reward logic. Abundant describes turning customer workflows into Foundry environments; Refresh describes simulated coding and computer-use worlds; Bespoke describes company-scale simulations; HackerRank Bench offers resettable repository environments and hidden verifiers; Prime Intellect advertises SFT fine-tuning, hosted RL on managed Prime-RL, inference and compute alongside its environment tooling. A buyer should separate environment authorship from hosted execution and post-training services. Portability, reset determinism, observability, judge calibration and maintenance obligations can matter as much as the number of tasks in a package. The platform description does not establish a human-data workforce or bespoke task-authoring service.

Evidence: candidate.cohort4.abundant_ai.foundry-customer-offer, candidate.cohort4.refresh.simulation-environments, candidate.cohort5.bespoke_labs.simulation-scope, candidate.cohort5.hackerrank.rl-package, repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.candidate.cohort4.prime_intellect.managed-training-platform

Analysis

Evaluation and safety services may use expert data without selling a general annotation workforce. Giskard offers dynamic evaluation data and adaptive attacks; Alinia describes policy judges and comparison with customer experts; Trajectory describes expert-discovered safety attacks and automated testing of known attacks. Their documented value propositions concern discovery, assessment and iteration. A procurement team should specify whether the output is a test dataset, a report, an integrated judge, a remediation cycle or a continuous service before comparing prices or treating these providers as substitutes for custom training-data production.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.giskard.evaluation-data-tooling, candidate.cohort5.giskard.adaptive-redteaming, candidate.cohort5.alinia.policy-judge-service, candidate.cohort5.alinia.expert-validation, candidate.cohort5.trajectory_labs_pbc.safety-evaluation-method

Analysis

Engineering teams and talent programs can occupy a distinct contractual position. A.Team offers builders for environment and evaluation engineering. G2i advertises engineering data programs and dual-developer review, yet its inspected human-data terms limit the service to talent acquisition and disclaim responsibility for candidate work. Proximal’s MSA instead keeps responsibility for subcontracted services with Proximal. These documents demonstrate why a shared engineering capability label cannot establish who warrants the final artifact. The contract should identify the accountable supplier, the accepted output and the path for defects.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.a-team.rl-engineering-offer, candidate.cohort4.g2i.engineering-data-programs, repair20261111.claim.current-reference192, candidate.cohort4.proximal.subcontractor-responsibility

Analysis

Annotation software is another distinct responsibility model. Dataloop documents human/AI feedback nodes; Datasaur combines automated NLP pre-labeling with human verification; Kili lets customer specialists author and judge post-training examples and introduces external partners; V7 Darwin supports multistage workflows and advertised specialist access. These products can support human-data production without establishing that the software company directly employs the annotators or warrants every add-on’s delivery. Compare platform controls, expert access and managed-service responsibility as separate line items.

Evidence: candidate.cohort6.dataloop.rlhf-rlaif-workflows, candidate.cohort6.datasaur.human-machine-labeling, candidate.cohort6.kili_technology.expert-data-platform, candidate.cohort6.kili_technology.partner-boundary, candidate.cohort6.v7.review-workflows, candidate.cohort6.v7.reseller-delivery-boundary

Analysis

Modality and domain are independent comparison dimensions. Encord offers physical-AI, multimodal and LLM annotation with role matching; APTO lists image, video, LiDAR, text and audio; Shaip describes credentialed professionals for healthcare, legal, finance and code preference work. A modality claim does not establish specialist expertise, and a credential claim does not establish coverage in every language or format. Buyers should intersect the required domain, locale, tool environment and output type, rather than add separate broad claims into an unsupported statement of complete coverage.

Evidence: candidate.cohort3.encord.managed-annotation, candidate.cohort3.encord.expert-matching, candidate.cohort5.apto.modalities, candidate.cohort3.shaip.expert-matching

Method

Provider categories are overlapping analyst groupings of documented offerings, not mutually exclusive market segments. A supplier can appear in several use-case comparisons without being counted several times. A brand, product, division or contractor platform is not automatically a separate corporate supplier. RWS/TrainAI, Welocalize/Welo Data, HackerRank/Bench and Alegion/SanctifAI retain the scoped identity disclosed in their records. Historical aliases remain searchable without inventing a new ownership transaction or a second supplier.

Analysis

Named delivery strengthens the ability to ask focused diligence questions, but evidence type still matters. DataForce’s IBM case, SuperAnnotate’s Databricks case, Aya Data’s Cydar case and Keymakr’s SeeChange case are provider-authored descriptions with different artifacts and dates. They are not matched outcome trials. A supplier without a named public case in this graph may have confidential deliveries; a supplier with one has not thereby demonstrated superior quality. Disclosure completeness and provider performance are distinct objects of study.

Evidence: candidate.cohort2.dataforce.ibm-delivery, candidate.cohort2.superannotate.databricks-delivery, repair20261111.claim.current-reference158, candidate.cohort3.keymakr.seechange-delivery

Research gap

The sample cannot support a commercial quadrant, market size, share estimate, concentration index, price curve or fastest-growing-provider list. Comparable segment revenue, current buyer demand, accepted-unit volume, active paid contributor windows and task-matched outcomes are missing or inconsistent. The report instead makes a narrower, falsifiable judgment: supplier comparison should follow responsibility and deliverable structure. A later study could test that judgment using matched contracts, acceptance logs and common pilot tasks.

Analysis

A managed annotation offer and an annotation method are different comparison objects. CrowdAgent describes routing and hidden-gold aggregation; LMCrowd describes staged model-label purchasing. Neither establishes that a named supplier currently implements those workflows or achieves their results. For managed work, compare responsibility for guidelines, routing, escalation, independent acceptance and full cost. For a method implementation, compare the exact data, models, selection rules and held-out checks. A paper-to-practice connection can suggest questions without becoming an unsupported supplier-contribution edge.

Evidence: cohort9.claim.crowdagent.human-routing, cohort9.claim.crowdagent.hidden-gold, cohort9.claim.crowdagent.fixed-human-ratios, cohort9.claim.lmcrowd.hierarchy, cohort9.claim.lmcrowd.cost-boundary

Analysis

A second responsibility map concerns who creates the measurement, rather than who supplies a worker. WebGPT records contractor contributions to demonstrations and answer comparisons; StarCoder records a distinct PII annotation project; APEX-Agents records expert task/world/rubric construction; the rubric-quality study separates human taxonomy development from generated persona scoring. These source-specific roles are more informative than a blanket human-data label. Confidence is high in the documented distinctions and unestablished for their relative commercial value. A statement of work should identify deliverable authorship, independent review, acceptance authority and continuing maintenance for each stage.

Evidence: mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2112.09332.limitation, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2112.09332.method, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2112.09332.provenance, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2112.09332.result, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2305.06161.limitation, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2305.06161.main_result, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2305.06161.method, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2305.06161.provenance, mandatory1.claim.arxiv.2305.06161.result, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2601.14242.limitation, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2601.14242.method, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2601.14242.provenance, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2601.14242.result, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2604.01375.limitation, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2604.01375.method, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2604.01375.provenance, mandatory2.claim.arxiv.2604.01375.result

Source-backed finding

BenchFlow — reviewed adjacent environment software; commercial qualification pending. BenchFlow documentation instructs users to check solvability, no-op failures, verifier robustness and task flakiness before trusting scores. BenchFlow calls itself a frontier environment lab and says it ships SkillsBench, ClawsBench, PostTrain and their runtime. BenchFlow documentation describes fresh task sandboxes and retained records of attempts, calls, settings and workspaces. BenchFlow describes building stateful environments with services, files, tools, verifiers, traces and replay. The BenchFlow repository LICENSE file at the same pinned commit contains the Apache License 2.0. The BenchFlow README at commit a61a26f4db4d566de16928565ea58abf3dbaf064 says it describes BenchFlow 0.10. The pinned README describes storing run rewards, token usage and trajectories in the job directory. The pinned BenchFlow README lists Docker, Daytona, Modal and AgentCore as task sandbox backends for evaluation and RL training. The pinned README links an export interface for JSONL rows containing rewards and messages for training. BenchFlow docs say their current documented release is 0.9.2 and explicitly flag pages requiring the 0.10.0rc2 prerelease.

Evidence: candidate.cohort4.benchflow.benchmark-quality-controls, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.environment-lab, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.sandbox-records, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.skillsbench-publication, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.stateful-data-lab, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.pinned-code-license, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.pinned-readme-version, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.run-output-records, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.sandbox-backends, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.training-export-interface, repair.binding.v1.candidate.cohort4.benchflow.version-boundary

Analysis

BenchFlow — reviewed adjacent environment software; commercial qualification pending. Research software, documented controls and owned benchmark publication do not establish a managed data-supply contract. Confidence is moderate for the disclosed runtime scope and unestablished for commercial data delivery. An explicit current supply offer and source-backed engagement terms would change that disposition.

Evidence: candidate.cohort4.benchflow.benchmark-quality-controls, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.environment-lab, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.sandbox-records, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.skillsbench-publication, candidate.cohort4.benchflow.stateful-data-lab, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.pinned-code-license, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.pinned-readme-version, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.run-output-records, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.sandbox-backends, candidate.cohort6.benchflow.training-export-interface, repair.binding.v1.candidate.cohort4.benchflow.version-boundary

Source-backed finding

Quesma — adjacent analytics and verification scope. Quesma currently markets coding-agent analytics that attribute AI spending by project, person, task type and model. Quesma’s homepage says it built training environments for difficult multi-hour agent tasks. Quesma says its Blitzy audit reran solutions and checked trajectories for unauthorized network access, branches and leakage. Quesma’s website privacy policy names Quesma Poland Sp. z o.o. as website operator and data controller. Quesma publishes open coding-agent benchmarks covering puzzle solving, binary security analysis, instrumentation and compilation tasks. Quesma reports being contracted by Blitzy to audit and verify SWE-Bench Pro results.

Evidence: candidate.cohort4.quesma.current-analytics-product, candidate.cohort4.quesma.historical-training-environments, candidate.cohort4.quesma.trajectory-audit-method, candidate.cohort4.quesma.website-operator, repair.binding.v1.candidate.cohort4.quesma.public-benchmarks, repair20261111.claim.current-reference146

Analysis

Quesma — adjacent analytics and verification scope. The reported contracted Blitzy audit is a narrow evaluation role; it does not establish training-data authorship. Current analytics positioning does not prove all historic/private supply work ceased. Confidence is moderate for the disclosed role and low for unobserved business activity. A current task-production offering or independently confirmed delivery would change the supplier assessment.

Evidence: candidate.cohort4.quesma.current-analytics-product, candidate.cohort4.quesma.historical-training-environments, candidate.cohort4.quesma.trajectory-audit-method, candidate.cohort4.quesma.website-operator, repair.binding.v1.candidate.cohort4.quesma.public-benchmarks, repair20261111.claim.current-reference146

Source-backed finding

AIXI Labs — theoretical research scope. Its official footer identifies AIXI Labs as a fiscally sponsored project of Principles of Intelligence, a US nonprofit. AIXI Labs states that it shares research openly where possible, including failures. AIXI Labs describes its focus as theoretical AI-risk and mitigation research using AIXI variants. AIXI Labs says it develops methods to apply theoretical findings to real AI agents. Its research overview describes creating model variants with specific risks or safety measures.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.aixi.fiscal-sponsorship, candidate.cohort5.aixi.open-research-value, candidate.cohort5.aixi.safety-foundations, candidate.cohort5.aixi.translation-goal, candidate.cohort5.aixi.variants-method

Analysis

AIXI Labs — theoretical research scope. The fiscal-sponsorship statement and open-research goal support a research-organization description. Confidence is moderate for that scope and unestablished for commercial data services. A concrete current collection, annotation or evaluation service offer would change the inclusion interpretation.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.aixi.fiscal-sponsorship, candidate.cohort5.aixi.open-research-value, candidate.cohort5.aixi.safety-foundations, candidate.cohort5.aixi.translation-goal, candidate.cohort5.aixi.variants-method

Source-backed finding

Elorian — model access and illustrative annotation. Elorian’s privacy policy says free inputs/outputs are used for model training by default and API users are opted out by default. The October 16, 2026 Glimpse announcement offers the model through an API and chat interface. The announcement describes Glimpse using tools to write code, transform images and inspect video. Its robotics example shows Glimpse assigning object boxes and event timestamps to teleoperation material. Elorian’s homepage positions the organization around models for visual thinking.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.elorian.input-training-defaults, candidate.cohort5.elorian.model-api-release, candidate.cohort5.elorian.multimodal-tools, candidate.cohort5.elorian.robotics-label-example, candidate.cohort5.elorian.visual-model-business

Analysis

Elorian — model access and illustrative annotation. API/chat access and a robotics labeling example are model offerings, without a separately contracted data-production service. Confidence is moderate for that distinction and unmeasured for task effectiveness. A source-backed managed delivery offering and task-matched outputs would change the supplier assessment.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.elorian.input-training-defaults, candidate.cohort5.elorian.model-api-release, candidate.cohort5.elorian.multimodal-tools, candidate.cohort5.elorian.robotics-label-example, candidate.cohort5.elorian.visual-model-business

Source-backed finding

Laude Institute — research support and software scope. Laude’s about page says individual technologists fund the institute. Laude says it operates and supports openly published research and open-source projects. Its website terms identify the operator as Laude Research Institute PBC. Laude Institute describes combining grantmaking with hands-on support for computing researchers. Laude’s terms list code competitions, grant applications and a researcher impact index as website services.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.laude.individual-funding, candidate.cohort5.laude.open-research, candidate.cohort5.laude.operator-identity, candidate.cohort5.laude.research-support, candidate.cohort5.laude.website-service-scope

Analysis

Laude Institute — research support and software scope. The website operator is a PBC; institute branding and individual funding do not establish nonprofit status. Confidence is moderate for the disclosed research-support role and unestablished for a commercial data-supply offering. A concrete current service and independently confirmed task delivery would change that boundary.

Evidence: candidate.cohort5.laude.individual-funding, candidate.cohort5.laude.open-research, candidate.cohort5.laude.operator-identity, candidate.cohort5.laude.research-support, candidate.cohort5.laude.website-service-scope
